title: sex-specific differences of right heart size in patients with pulmonary arterial hypertension
summary: The target of this study is to examine if there is a sex-specific difference in the right heart size of patients with pulmonary hypertension at initial diagnosis, at the start time of first targeted medication treatment and six months after. It  will also be investigated if there is a correlation with  right heart function and possible effects on risk stratification, therapy and prognosis.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Adult patients with PAH who are capable of giving consent
• Patients with invasively confirmed PAH 
• Invasive, guideline-based diagnosed PAH: 
RHK: mPAP > 20 mmHg, PAWP ≤ 15 mmHg, PVR ≥3 WU 
• Patients receiving drug therapy for the treatment of PAH.
Exclusion criteria:
• Underage patients
• Patients who are incapable of giving consent
• Pregnant patients 
• Relevant comorbidities that speak against the presence of PAH 
• Patients whose gender identity does not correspond to their biological sex
